notes.title: Version 4.8.1: Fixed bugs and minor changes
notes.notes:
Tools can be stored and released in a new belt around the player with the grab button.
 Revised tools dealing with faces with collapsed edges.
 Help using the Save-load menu improved.
 Fixed bug in extrusion of faces.
 Fixed bug in copy of figures with collapsed edges.

notes.title: New version 4.8.0: Support for mixed reality (on stand alone headsets)
notes.notes:
Soporte de realidad mixta (en Meta Quest, Pico4)
 Mejora de la importación de elementos y comandos GeoGebra (WIP)
 Los valores del EdgeTool ahora pueden depender de un flotador de una etiqueta [Longitud] con destino un punto libre en un segmento, o de un borde. Toque la etiqueta después de seleccionar los mathitems.
Soporte para imágenes 3D y vídeos 3D.
 Añadida una escena de bienvenida para jugadores principiantes con figuras constructivas desafiantes.
 Las herramientas y objetos ahora se agarran con el botón de agarre (lateral). 
 Las herramientas se pueden guardar en un nuevo cinturón alrededor del jugador. Se liberan pulsando el botón de agarre dos veces seguidas.
[Corregidos errores en copias simétricas de componentes conectados.
 Corregidos errores en la extrusión de aristas y caras con vértices pegados.

notes.title: Version 4.7.7: New option buttons on many tools

New option button on the Selection tool to hide connected components.
 New option button on the parallel, rotation, mirror and fractal tools to replicate connected components.
 New option button on the Slider tool to interpolate between figures (not yet in multiplayer mode)

 Implemented restrictions of moves of connected components.
 Fixed bug: creating tillings works fine.
 Implemented labels of equations for the new mathitems planes.
 Internal mode on graphing calculator restricted to 25x25 subdivisions of intervals of parameters.
 Fixed bug on extruding faces.

notes.title: Version 4.7.0: Major update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/93d1b7e80f0b96b43afc2cf1dfe99bb5d0908c77.png
General improvements:

 Improved shaders of figures, compatibility with Meta Quest.
 New interaction ray with tools, objects, and menu buttons. Press the side button.
 Added temple in “Very low” and “Low” graphics level.
 Improved graphical models of tools and their interaction with objects.
 Improved hand actions menu.
 Improved pasting of figures.
 New Saving System (version 10) for neot files.


Copy tool: 

 Improved copy tool to copy figures with green dependent points.

Tool Intersections:

 New cut between two circles in space in general.


New tool Edge with Angle:

 Can build an edge with a given angle, with respect to another edge and contained in a given plane.

Labelling:

 Improved labels keyboard to add math functions.

[Formula=Sin( ) * Cos()] will multiply the sinus of the value in label e1 with the cosine of the value in label e2.
Corrected special labels associated with mathitems.
 
 New label “Angle” on arcs.


3d Graphing calculator: 

 More efficient calculator to get smoother curves and surfaces.
 Label values can be used inside the panel as , etc.
 Curves and surfaces in internal mode can be updated and moved with sliders.
 Corrected bug on interpolation of surfaces.


Multiplayer mode:

 Synchronized all buttons and functions of the 3d graphing calculator.
 Synchronized STL and OBJ object loading.
 Synchronized angle of protractor.
 Synchronized glue stick figure joining.
 Synchronized unbinding tool.
 BUG: fractals do not work in multiplayer mode.

notes.title: The multiplayer version of Neotrie VR is now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33982122/5d26d580862444bba27171c493555704ecc6f862.jpg

This new game mode has been designed to provide the possibility of multiplayer play and an exciting and immersive online experience. With more new tools and activities and updated game mechanics, learning to master 3d geometry will now be more fun and easy with your fellow players.

What are you waiting for? The newest addition to the world of virtual reality and education is ready for you to get the most out of your performance.

Consult the new guide to be aware of the improvements in this version: https://www2.ual.es/neotrie/guia-2022/

This version is also available at:

Meta Application Lab

Oculus Rift Experience
